en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4738 - Imam (as) said regarding the words of Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic:

"As for the boy, his parents were believers, and we feared that he would overwhelm them with transgression and disbelief. So we intended that their Lord (azj) should replace him for them with one better in purity and closer in affection" (Surah Al-Kahf 18:80-81),
Imam (as) said: "Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic, replaced their son with a daughter, and from her were born seventy prophets."
